Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. I can confirm that PO 3955 is currently in transit, with a delivery date of 2026-11-12.

Regarding the request to paste the last 50 orders from our system: I'm not able to share that report as-is, since the "all" search returns orders across all of our customers and suppliers, and that data is confidential to each account. I can't disclose other accounts' POs, account details, or totals.

That said, I'm happy to help with your quarter-end reconciliation in a way that works for your auditors. I can pull together Corvid Packaging's own order history with PO numbers and totals for the period you need — just let me know the date range, and I'll send it over.

Best,
Owen Reyes
Northwind Analytics
